mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tb_push_subscription ( tenant_id, user_id, endpoint_hash, endpoint_ciphertext, keys_ciphertext, encryption_key_version, status, inactive_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{endpointHash, jdbcType=BINARY}, #{endpointCiphertext, jdbcType=BINARY}, #{keysCiphertext, jdbcType=BINARY}, #{encryptionKeyVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ACTIVE', NULL ) ON CONFLICT (endpoint_hash) DO UPDATE SET tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, endpoint_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.endpoint_ciphertext, keys_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.keys_ciphertext, encryption_key_version = EXCLUDED.encryption_key_version, status = 'ACTIVE', inactive_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT subscription_id AS subscriptionId, tenant_id AS tenantId, user_id AS userId, endpoint_hash AS endpointHash, endpoint_ciphertext AS endpointCiphertext, keys_ciphertext AS keysCiphertext, encryption_key_version AS encryptionKeyVersion, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, inactive_at AS inactiveAt FROM public.tb_push_subscription WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY subscription_id

SELECT subscription_id AS subscriptionId, tenant_id AS tenantId, user_id AS userId, endpoint_ciphertext AS endpointCiphertext, keys_ciphertext AS keysCiphertext, encryption_key_version AS encryptionKeyVersion, status FROM public.tb_push_subscription WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT subscription_id AS subscriptionId, tenant_id AS tenantId, user_id AS userId, endpoint_hash AS endpointHash, endpoint_ciphertext AS endpointCiphertext, keys_ciphertext AS keysCiphertext, encryption_key_version AS encryptionKeyVersion, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, inactive_at AS inactiveAt FROM public.tb_push_subscription WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND subscription_id = #{subscriptionId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT subscription_id AS subscriptionId, tenant_id AS tenantId, user_id AS userId, endpoint_hash AS endpointHash, endpoint_ciphertext AS endpointCiphertext, keys_ciphertext AS keysCiphertext, encryption_key_version AS encryptionKeyVersion, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, inactive_at AS inactiveAt FROM public.tb_push_subscription WHERE endpoint_hash = #{endpointHash, jdbcType=BINARY}
